data.name: Aura of Comfort
data.description: A wilderness warden is comfortable in nearly any climate, as if she were affected by a constant endure elements spell, and she and allies within 10 feet of her gain a +4 bonus on Constitution checks and saving throws to resist fatigue; exhaustion; and the effects of hunger, thirst, and hot or cold climates (including from magical effects).
